title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊想要
当邮差
文/唐梦敏
图/抱抱小枕头
邮差大马先生生病了，可他还有一堆包裹没送出去呢。
“大马先生，让我帮你送包裹吧，我早就想当一名邮差
了！”小熊热情地说。
大马先生指了指最上面的一个小盒子：“那就请
你把这盒巧克力送到松……”
“巧克力”三个字好像散发出甜蜜蜜的香气，在
小熊的心里飘啊飘。
大马先生后面说的话，小熊
一个字也没听进去。
小熊拿着巧克力飞快地跑出门。
是送到哪里呢？
对了！小熊一拍脑门：肯定是松
鼠家！
page_text_en:
Little Bear Wants to Be a Postman
Text by Tang Mengmin
Illustrations by Bao Bao Xiao Toushu
The postman, Mr. Da Ma, was sick, but he still had a pile of packages to deliver.
"Mr. Da Ma, let me help you deliver the packages! I've always wanted to be a postman!" Little Bear said enthusiastically.
Mr. Da Ma pointed to a small box on top: "Then please deliver this box of chocolate to the松..."
The word "chocolate" seemed to emit a sweet, sweet fragrance, drifting through Little Bear's heart.
The words Mr. Da Ma said after that, Little Bear didn't hear a single one.
Little Bear grabbed the chocolate and ran out the door quickly.
Where should it be delivered?
Ah! Little Bear slapped his forehead: It must be to the squirrel's house!
summary_zh: 小熊主动提出帮生病的邮差大马先生送包裹，大马先生让他送一盒巧克力，但小熊只听到“巧克力”三个字，便兴奋地跑出门，认定要送到松鼠家。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
“巧克力？谁会给我巧克力？”松鼠先生正在闹牙疼，他捂着腮帮子，瞄了瞄小熊手中的包裹，“不是我的，不是我的，这上面清清楚楚写着‘松鸡太太收’。”

小熊涨红了脸——刚才，他的脑子一定被巧克力糊住了！
“我、我……我这就去找松鸡太太！”
page_text_en:
"Chocolate? Who would give me chocolate?" Mr. Squirrel was having a toothache. He held his cheek and looked at the package in Little Bear's hands. "Not mine, not mine. It clearly says 'To Mrs. Grouse.'"

Little Bear turned red in the face—just now, his brain must have been stuck with chocolate!
"I, I... I'll go find Mrs. Grouse right away!"
summary_zh: 小熊把包裹送到松鼠家，松鼠先生因牙疼拒绝接收，指出包裹是给松鸡太太的。小熊意识到自己听错了，决定去找松鸡太太。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
“亲爱的小邮差，你来得正好！我还有一件东西要请你送一送。”松鸡太太收下巧克力，把小熊请进自己的家。
小松鸡们正在玩飞行棋，这也是小熊的最爱。
当然喽，小熊现在是个小邮差，他也不能忘掉邮差的责任！
page_text_en:
"Dear little postman, you've come just in time! I have one more thing for you to deliver." Mrs. Grouse took the chocolate and invited the little bear into her home.
The little grouse chicks were playing a board game, which was also the little bear's favorite.
Of course, the little bear is now a postman, and he can't forget his responsibilities!
summary_zh: 小熊来到松鸡太太家，她请他帮忙送一件东西，并邀请他进屋。屋内小松鸡们正在玩飞行棋，小熊虽然喜欢游戏，但牢记自己作为邮差的责任。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh: “拜托你把这篮草莓送到灰……”松鸡太太一边说，一边把草莓装好了递到小熊的手里。可小熊伸长脖子只顾着看飞行棋。飞行棋好像变成了小鸟，在小熊的心里扑腾着翅膀。松鸡太太的话，只有一小半儿钻进了他的耳朵里。
page_text_en: "Please deliver this basket of strawberries to Gray..." Mrs. Pine Chicken said, while packing the strawberries and handing them to the little bear. But the little bear stretched his neck, only watching the board game. The board game seemed to turn into little birds, fluttering their wings in the little bear's heart. Mrs. Pine Chicken's words only half entered his ears.
summary_zh: 松鸡太太请小熊帮忙送一篮草莓，但小熊因专注看小松鸡们玩飞行棋，只听进了一半话，未能准确记住收件人。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
“草莓？谁会送酸溜溜的草莓给我这个老掉牙的家伙？”灰鼠爷爷不高兴，他戴上老花镜看了看贴在篮子上的纸条，“不是我的，不是我的，这上面清清楚楚地写着‘灰兔奶奶收’。”
小熊涨红了脸——刚才，他一定是被飞行棋迷住了心窍！
“我，我，我……这就找灰兔奶奶去！”
page_text_en:
"Strawberries? Who would send sour strawberries to an old toothless fellow like me?" Grandpa Gray Mouse was unhappy. He put on his reading glasses and looked at the note on the basket, "Not mine, not mine, it clearly says 'To Grandma Gray Rabbit.'"
Bear blushed—just now, he must have been completely distracted by the board game!
"Me, me, me... I'll go find Grandma Gray Rabbit right away!"
summary_zh: 小熊将草莓篮送错给灰鼠爷爷，对方拒绝接收并指出收件人是灰兔奶奶。小熊意识到自己又听错了，羞愧地决定去找灰兔奶奶。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
灰兔奶奶用草莓榨了好多草莓汁，
小熊和小灰兔喝得可高兴了。

“谢谢你，亲爱的小邮差，草莓是我家小兔兔的最爱。
请进来，我还有件东西要请你送一送。”灰兔奶奶收下草莓篮子，把小熊安尼让进自己的家。
“我织了一条好看的围巾，你看，上面绣满了小雏菊……”你帮我把它送到河马太太家旁的……
哎呀呀，灰兔奶奶说话慢吞吞的，小熊可没有什么耐心听。
不过，她榨的草莓汁味道不错，酸酸甜甜的，小熊好喜欢！
page_text_en:
Grandma Gray Rabbit squeezed a lot of strawberry juice,
and Little Bear and Little Gray Rabbit were so happy drinking it.

"Thank you, dear little postman, strawberries are my little bunny's favorite.
Come in, I have another thing for you to deliver." Grandma Gray Rabbit took the strawberry basket and invited Little Bear Anni into her home.
"I knitted a beautiful scarf, look, it's embroidered with little daisies..." Please help me deliver it to the house next to Mrs. Hippo's...
Oh my, Grandma Gray Rabbit speaks so slowly, Little Bear doesn't have much patience to listen.
But the strawberry juice she made tastes great, sour and sweet, and Little Bear really likes it!
summary_zh: 小熊将草莓篮送到灰兔奶奶家，灰兔奶奶感谢他并请他帮忙送一条围巾给河马太太，但小熊因不耐烦而没听清收件人，只顾着喝美味的草莓汁。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
小熊还没喝够呢，一想到那个味道，
它就忍不住地砸嘴巴。
灰兔奶奶的话，只有一半钻进了它的耳朵。

小熊拿着围巾飞快地跑出了门。
是送到哪里呢？
对了！安尼一拍脑门：是河马太太家！这一次，
小熊听对了吗？

跑过小石桥，穿过芦草地，踏上软软的
沙滩。
河马太太的家，在一块大石头的旁边。
小熊安尼敲了敲贝壳门环——咚咚咚。
page_text_en:
The little bear hadn't had enough yet; just thinking about the taste made him lick his lips.
Only half of Grandma Gray Rabbit's words got into his ears.

The little bear ran out the door with the scarf.
Where should he deliver it?
Got it! Anni slapped his forehead: Mrs. Hippo's house! This time,
did the little bear hear correctly?

He ran over the little stone bridge, through the reed meadow, and onto the soft sandy beach.
Mrs. Hippo's house was beside a big rock.
Little bear Anni knocked on the shell door knocker—dong dong dong.
summary_zh: 小熊因贪恋草莓汁的味道而没听清灰兔奶奶的话，只记住要送围巾，却忘了收件人。他自以为听对了，跑向河马太太家，并敲响了门环。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
“围巾？你确定这是送我的围巾吗？”
河马太太的眼睛瞪得像铜铃，“我看这条围巾只能给我擦鼻涕呀。”

“没错呀，我听灰兔奶奶说河马太太家…………”小熊使劲挠了挠脑袋瓜。

“是我托了灰兔奶奶织围巾的。”年轻的河狸小姐从大石头的另一边钻了出来，“大概是灰兔奶奶怕我的家不好找，跟你说是河马太太家旁边吧！”
page_text_en:
"Scarf? Are you sure this is for me?" 
Hippo太太's eyes bulged like bells. "I can only use this scarf to wipe my nose!"

"It's correct, I heard Grandma Gray Rabbit say it's for Hippo太太's house..." the little bear scratched his head hard.

"It was me who asked Grandma Gray Rabbit to knit the scarf," the young beaver girl popped out from the other side of the big stone. "Probably Grandma Gray Rabbit thought my house was hard to find, so she told you it's next to Hippo太太's house!"
summary_zh: 小熊将围巾送到了河马太太家，河马太太觉得围巾不适合自己，小熊这才意识到送错了。这时，真正的收件人河狸小姐出现，解释是灰兔奶奶怕地址难找，才让小熊误以为是河马太太家旁边。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
噢！应该是这样啦。
小熊想，是因为草莓汁的原因吧，他又把灰兔奶奶的话给丢掉了一小截儿。
可是河马太太和河狸小姐都没有责怪他，这让他十分内疚。

“那么，河马太太，河狸小姐，你们还有什么需要送的吗？”小熊安尼认认真真地说，“今天，我想当一次不再出错的邮差。”
page_text_en:
Oh! That must be it.
Bear thought, it must be because of the strawberry juice; he had dropped a little bit of what Mrs. Gray Rabbit said again.
But Mrs. Hippo and Miss Beaver didn't scold him, which made him feel very guilty.

"So, Mrs. Hippo, Miss Beaver, is there anything else you need delivered?" Bear Anni said seriously, "Today, I want to be a postman who doesn't make any mistakes anymore."
summary_zh: 小熊因送错围巾而感到内疚，但河马太太和河狸小姐并未责怪他。他决心认真工作，不再出错，主动询问是否还有其他邮件需要送达。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
“那就帮我把祝福送给亲爱的大马先生吧！”
“对，对，我也要！”
“我也要！”
送祝福的人还真不少呢，大马先生果然是那个最受欢迎的人嘛。
“好呀，好呀，一个个来。我会把‘祝福’一句不落地捎给大马先生！”
瞧瞧，小熊现在听得多么认真啊！
page_text_en:
"Then help me send my blessing to dear Mr. Horse!"
"Yes, yes, I want one too!"
"Me too!"
There are quite a few people sending blessings—Mr. Horse is clearly the most popular!
"Alright, alright, one by one. I’ll deliver every single 'blessing' to Mr. Horse!"
Look, how attentively the little bear is listening now!
summary_zh: 小熊认真倾听大家为大马先生送上祝福，表现出专注和责任感，与之前送错邮件形成对比。

title_en: Little Bear Wants to Be a Mail Carrier
page_text_ocr_zh:
包裹送给谁？
大马先生又有几个包裹让小熊送了，这次小熊又没有
认真听。你能根据提示，帮助他找到每个包裹的主人吗？
★蓝莓派的主人住在树上。
★手套的主人家旁边有条河，门前有一块篱笆地。
★鲜花的主人家门前放了两盆花。
page_text_en:
Who is the package for?
Mr. Horse has a few more packages for Little Bear to deliver. This time, Little Bear isn't listening carefully. Can you use the clues to help him find the owner of each package?
★ The owner of the blueberry pie lives in a tree.
★ The owner of the gloves lives next to a river, with a fenced garden in front of their house.
★ The owner of the flowers has two flowerpots in front of their house.
summary_zh: 本页呈现了一个互动游戏页面，大马先生让小熊送三个包裹（蓝莓派、手套、鲜花），但小熊没有认真听，需要读者根据提示（如住树上、旁边有河、门前有两盆花）帮助小熊找到正确的收件人。
